barOfTheWeek.blurb: Live country music, cold drinks, and a rooftop on Lower Broadway.
barOfTheWeek.history: The Stage is one of the honky-tonks that grew up with Lower Broadway. An original painting of The Highwaymen, once owned by Waylon Jennings and hung in his Nashville home, hangs over the front door.

offers.title: Live music
offers.detail: Country bands on the main floor, the second floor, and the rooftop.

offers.title: Hours
offers.detail: Open every day, 10 AM to 2:30 AM. Artists and times can change.

offers.title: Private events
offers.detail: Private parties, corporate events, and VIP rooms.

bandSpotlight.name: Mac Watts
bandSpotlight.story: Mac Watts grew up just north of Detroit and moved to Nashville in 2017. He has released the EPs Dynamite and Cast Away, plus the singles On My Own and Raise Em Up Proud. He plays regularly on Broadway, including sets at The Stage on Broadway.
